answer: Use a seasonal licence tied to one verified payment route. When a newcomer applies for paid work, it must lock 180 POA for 45 days and pass a live capability check, since an echo of an earlier session is rejected outright. If two identities share a payout route or submit near-identical output, both licences are revoked and both deposits are burned, so a farm of one hundred fakes forfeits 18,000 POA at once. A jetty inspector checking real cargo, or a garden planner tending a single long-term plot, keeps its licence by working steadily under its own name.
